artifacts.name: database-schema
artifacts.description: Table and column reference with FK relationships and constraints. Check before writing any DB query or schema-dependent feature; the migration chain is the database-migrations artifact.

artifacts.name: database-migrations
artifacts.description: Alembic chain: revision history 0001 onward, how to add and verify a migration (set DATABASE_URL; unset targets prod), and how it differs from data_migration.py. Check before writing any migration.

artifacts.name: deployment
artifacts.description: Server lifecycle, systemd service management, address validation workflow, backfill commands, and full ops reference. Check before touching infra, services, or env config.

artifacts.name: memory-pressure
artifacts.description: No swap, co-hosted prod: the memory budget, earlyoom and slice configs in infra/, how to verify them, and the SocratiCode version pins. Check before changing memory settings, earlyoom, or the SocratiCode pin.

artifacts.name: source-page
artifacts.description: WSLCB source page HTML structure and field label quirks. Must consult when touching parser.py or any scraping/parsing logic.

artifacts.name: style
artifacts.description: Brand colors, CSS conventions, and Tailwind usage patterns. Check before modifying templates or adding new UI components.

artifacts.name: infra
artifacts.description: Host configuration: systemd units and timers for all services (web, scraper, address validation, healthcheck), plus the memory-pressure configs that keep the web service alive under exhaustion on this swapless VM (service + parent-slice MemoryLow, OOMScoreAdjust, vm.min_free_kbytes, earlyoom). Consult when modifying service configuration, adding scheduled tasks, or touching OOM/memory behaviour.

artifacts.name: research
artifacts.description: Architectural review findings and design decisions (architecture-review.md — consult before proposing structural changes), plus domain research: entity classification, template analysis, data audits, and record linking analysis. Relevant for work on entities, record linking, and data quality.

artifacts.name: plans
artifacts.description: Dated implementation plans and design docs (2026-03 onward), including the superseded SQLite-to-PostgreSQL phase plans. Design history, not current behaviour: may describe values or schemas a later migration changed. Search with artifactName set when asking why something was built a certain way.

artifacts.name: specs
artifacts.description: Dated design specs (the docs/superpowers/specs override, #176): the design intent behind a feature at the time it was written. Design history, not current behaviour; confirm against source.

artifacts.name: socraticode
artifacts.description: Code exploration reference: the full SocratiCode tool table, a pointer to the prefetch hook, per-tool notes, graph-health and index-scope guidance. The on-demand half of the Code Exploration Policy block in AGENTS.md.
